body.name: reference bump density
body.construction:
For \(a\in\mathbb R\), let
\[
 \widetilde g_0(a)=
 \begin{cases}
 \exp\{-1/(B_A^2-a^2)\},& |a|<B_A,\\
 0,& |a|\ge B_A,
 \end{cases}
 \quad
 g_0(a)=\frac{\widetilde g_0(a)}
 {\int_{\mathbb R}\widetilde g_0(v)\,dv}.
\]
Define
\[
 R_{f,0}=\|g_0\|_{H^\beta(\mathbb R)},
 \quad
 \kappa_0=\min_{a\in I}g_0(a).
\]
